name: order-replication-utility
description: Local order replication tool: worker + UI sharing one SQLite DB

scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/worker && npm run build -w @app/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @app/worker" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
